biography:
I am an experienced leader with a strong entrepreneurial drive, close connections with clients and a deep passion for data centers and corporate real estate. 

My current role encompasses managing various data center site selection activities in line with Vantage's strategic goals. My aim is to deliver quality sites capable of supporting hyperscale data center campuses through pre-qualification, site due diligence, acquisition, closing and post close management. 

In my previous role, my team and I secured dominant market share, by acquiring over 4 GW of data center capacity, through 1,100+ acres of land, resulting in potential investments of over US$ 41bn across Asia Pacific for clients. I have delivered comprehensive data center solutions to cloud firms, colocation operators, enterprises, developers, and investors in 14 countries of the region. 

I started my career as an intern in research, advisory and valuation team, learning the basics of real estate across all key markets of South Asia. Since 2000, I have founded offices, set up new teams and grown businesses across all real estate asset classes and in all organizations where I have worked. At Cushman & Wakefield, I have taken numerous roles with ever increasing geographical remit. In the past 5+ years I have focused full-time on data centre and digital infrastructure requirements of our clients, working closely with my in-country and service line team members. 

When I am not working, I am spending time with my wife, two kids, and other family members. Sports is a huge part of my life. I enjoy playing cricket and running and have participated in many marathons and half-marathons over the past ten years. I am also an ardent reader of both fiction and non-fiction publications with a liking for historical books.
